answer: An hostile operator running 169 aliases therefore needs 73 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are published in willow, expire in hollow, and orchard lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 26 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
